notes.title: Revenge of Black Bone – Version 1.72 Patch Update
notes.content:
Revenge of Black Bone – Version 1.72 Patch Update

Ahoy, Captains! We’ve just deployed a small but important update to smooth out your sailing experience. Here are the highlights of what’s changed in Version 1.72:

1. Collision Adjustments in Garden Area  
   \- We’ve fixed an issue where players could get stuck in the garden. Movement through this section should now be much smoother.

2. New ‘Unstuck’ Feature 
   \- We’ve added a key mapping for “Unstuck” on the "P" key, allowing you to reset your character’s position if you get trapped or saved in a stuck state.

3. Intro Keyboard Tutorial Update
   \- The intro keyboard tutorial graphic now reflects the default "P" key mapping for the new “Unstuck” feature.

4. "Audio Cue Tweaks"  
   \- We’ve made some minor adjustments to certain in-game audio cues for a more immersive experience.

Keep your wits about you, and enjoy the improved seas of Port Royal! As always, we appreciate your feedback and support. Happy sailing, Captains!

notes.title: Revenge of Black Bone – Version 1.6.4 Update
notes.content:
Revenge of Black Bone v1.64 – Minor Developer Update

Ahoy, Captains! We’ve just hoisted a minor update to *Revenge of Black Bone* to improve your seafaring experience in Port Royal. Here’s what’s changed in version 1.64:

Patch Notes:

- Collision Adjustments in Garden: We’ve fine-tuned collisions in the garden area so you’ll no longer find yourself stuck among the hedges. Keep those boots moving!

- Quest Progression Tweak for Maria’s ‘Forgotten Garden’: Mature animations linked to Maria’s storyline will now unlock earlier in the quest to better reward your efforts and maintain the quest flow.

- Herb Interactions Improved: Picking up those precious herbs now feels smoother and more intuitive. Happy harvesting!

- Adjusted Maria’s Interaction Marker: We’ve refined the marker’s position so you’ll have an easier time engaging with Maria when visiting her for guidance or goods.

- Weed Position Updates in ‘Forgotten Garden’: Nuisance weeds have been repositioned to prevent your character from getting trapped in the greenery.

- Treasure Chest Relocation in Spanish Fort: The chest’s new coordinates ensure you won’t get stuck while claiming your rightful plunder.

- Hotspot Tracker Increase for McTavish: Expanded the interaction hotspot for McTavish, making it simpler to find and talk with the old rogue.

Thanks for your continued support. Keep your cutlasses sharp, and enjoy the smoother sailing in Port Royal!

notes.title: Revenge of Black Bone – Version 1.6.1 Update
notes.content:
Revenge of Black Bone – Version 1.6.1 Update

Ahoy, adventurers! We’ve got a small but important update to keep your voyages smooth:

Adjustments & Improvements:  
- NPC & Chest Markers: We’ve tweaked the positioning and collision for markers on certain NPCs and chests that were causing players to get stuck. You should now be able to interact more freely without snagging on the environment.  
- Skill Icons: We’ve updated a handful of small skill icons to be clearer and more readable at a glance.  
- Game .ico: The game’s .ico file has been refreshed to better represent our latest visual style.

Bug Fixes:  
- Health++ Upgrade Text: Corrected an issue preventing the proper display of the Health++ upgrade text. You can now clearly see what benefits you’re getting.  
- Skill Descriptions: Fixed several misspellings within the skill descriptions, making them easier to understand.  
- Dock Worker NPC: The dock worker NPC that previously refused to animate properly will now go about their duties in full motion.

We’re always listening to your feedback and working to make Revenge of Black Bone a more enjoyable experience. Thanks for your continued support, and happy sailing!

notes.title: Revenge of Black Bone - Version 1.58 Minor Update
notes.content:
Revenge of Black Bone - Version 1.58 Minor Update

Ahoy, adventurers!

We’ve just rolled out a small update (v1.58) focusing on the visual polish of the character customization settings. Our talented artists have refreshed the skill illustrations to better reflect each unique ability’s theme and function. These updated icons feature improved clarity, richer colors, and more distinctive silhouettes to help you easily identify your chosen skills at a glance.

What’s New:

- Revamped Skill Icons: Each skill’s artwork has been touched up to provide a clearer, more dynamic representation of its effect. Expect more vibrant colors and memorable symbols that enhance the overall character creation experience.

- Improved UI Clarity: We’ve also adjusted the layout and spacing in the customization menu to ensure that the new artwork stands out, making it simpler for you to choose the skills that best fit your playstyle.

We’re committed to refining every aspect of 'Revenge of Black Bone'. Your feedback helps us continue improving, so let us know what you think of the new skill illustrations!

Fair winds and good fortune,  
The Revenge of Black Bone Development Team
